newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high, forestry up.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high, forestry up.

text.p: 1600 - Swedish share prices closed at a record high on Wednesday, as a jump in the forestry sector balanced falls in blue-chips Ericsson and Astra.
* Stockholm general index rises 0.20 percent to 2,610.23
* Telecommunications group Ericsson falls two crowns to 246 in the wake of its 1996 result, not matching losses in the share price overnight
* Drug company Astra falls two crowns to 355.5, off highs during the session
Swedish shares rose slightly to end at record high levels on Wednesday as a jump in the forestry sector balanced falls in blue-chips telecoms group Ericsson and drugs major Astra.
The general index rose 0.20 percent to a record high of 2,610.23. Trading was heavy with turnover amounting to 5.8 billion crowns.
Ericsson fell two crowns to 246 in the wake of its 1996 result, released a day earlier, but still did not match losses in the share price overnight.
Drug company Astra fell two crowns to 355.5.
